preconditions.description: The number of grooms n must be between 1 and 100.
The number of times the princess said 'Oh...' a must be between 0 and 15.
The number of times the princess exclaimed 'Wow!' b must be between 0 and 15.
The total number of grooms n must be greater than the sum of a and b.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= ti <= 50000 for ti in t)
postconditions.description: Each fortune ti must be between 1 and 50000.
The length of the sequence t must be equal to n.

postconditions.expression: sum('Oh...' for ti in t) == a
postconditions.description: The number of times 'Oh...' is said must be equal to a.

postconditions.expression: sum('Wow!' for ti in t) == b
postconditions.description: The number of times 'Wow!' is exclaimed must be equal to b.
